finding.title: Use After Free
finding.trigger: If the stack is full and push is called again, it will write to a freed memory location
finding.assumptions: The stack does not handle the case where push is called when the stack is full.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The code includes a check on line 34 to ensure that the stack is not full before writing to the array. The condition `if (this->cnt < this->maxLen)` prevents writing to the array when the stack is full.

finding.title: Null Pointer Dereference

finding.assumptions: The stack does not handle the case where pop is called on an empty stack.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked for a null pointer dereference in the pop method. The code checks if 'cnt' is greater than 0 before accessing 'this->arr[--this->cnt]'. If 'cnt' is 0, it returns 'emptyValue' instead of dereferencing a null pointer.
